title: Loyalty Credit Rate Page for Vehicle Additions to a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy
content:
The loyalty credit percentage of a vehicle addition charge on a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy follows the named insured's Cardinal tenure.

## Rate

| Cardinal tenure, whole months | Loyalty credit percentage |
|---|---|
| 60 months or more | 10 percent |
| 36 months or more but under 60 | 5 percent |
| Under 36 months | Nil |

**Measuring tenure.** Tenure is counted in whole months from the policy's original inception date, as shown on the policy record, to the day the charge is booked.

## Boundaries (hypothetical)

| Original inception date | Day the charge is booked | Whole months | Percentage |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 May 2021 | 15 May 2026 | 60 | 10 percent |
| 15 May 2021 | 14 May 2026 | 59 | 5 percent |
| 15 May 2023 | 15 May 2026 | 36 | 5 percent |
| 15 May 2023 | 14 May 2026 | 35 | Nil |

## Points of judgement

- The inception date that counts is the policy's original inception date, not the start of the current term.
- The tenure is measured to the day the charge is booked, not to the effective date of the addition.
